rule: Work on one feature at a time. Complete the applicable Pre-Implementation Gate before coding. After implementing the real production path, scripts/ci.sh must pass. Then complete every applicable Production-Ready Gate item with evidence before marking passing or moving on. Scaffolds, placeholders, stubs, fake data, no-op adapters, and mocks do not satisfy production behavior.
reconciliationNote: Statuses below come from the 2026-09-22 repository reconciliation audit (commit 0433cc5 tree): every feature was traced end-to-end through real callers, backend wiring, auth, state ownership, provider integrations, error paths, and tests. VERIFIED is deliberately not assigned anywhere: no feature has real integration/hardware evidence satisfying the Production-Ready Gate, and the production Convex vault lacks PARALLEL_API_KEY, SERPAPI_API_KEY, CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID, CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, KITESURF_ALLOWED_DOMAINS, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, FAL_API_KEY, and BUNNY_* (verified 2026-09-18), so live provider paths fail closed.
